text:
Aisha: Heads up — p99 jumped ~2x on shared-gpu-pool-2 around 2026-03-17 14:01 UTC. /v1/generate throughput down ~30% for 5–10m. Affected: rwd/gpt-13b-quant (hosted)
Tom: Any deploys? :eyes:
Aisha: No deploys. Autoscaler ok. Perf-bot flagged kernel fallback on several workers.
perf-bot: Summary: KV cache eviction rate ↑, batching skew to tiny batches, kernel_selector picked dequant fallback on ~18% requests. Hotspots: kv_cache::evict, kernel_dispatch::fallback.
Jason: Paste profiler snippet?
perf-bot: ```
flame-summary
kv_cache::lookup 42%
kv_cache::evict 11%
kernel_dispatch::select 19%
kernel_exec::int8_dequant_path 18%
other 10%
```
Maria: Looks like one tenant hammering with huge prefixes.
Aisha: Correlation: tenant-bigctx-7. Median tokens per request way up; TTL churn high.
Tom: Sample payloads?
Aisha: Example: ~64k token session, frequent priming -> many unique KV keys, repeated inserts -> evict churn.
Jason: Eviction stalls inference threads -> batching collapses to tiny batches -> kernel selector opts conservative slower paths.
Maria: Short-term: cap concurrent sessions and prefix tokens for shared pools. Propose max_concurrent_sessions=8 and max_prefix_tokens=8192 for tenant-bigctx-7.
Tom: Applying rate-limit to shared-gpu-pool-2 now (in 5m).
infra-bot: Policy applied to pool=shared-gpu-pool-2 tenant=tenant-bigctx-7 (config.commit: rd-policy-20260317-1).
Aisha: After policy p99 back to baseline within 3m; throughput recovered; KV eviction down ~85%.
Jason: Root cause: eviction-heavy workload + batching heuristic degeneracy -> kernel fallback. Actions:
- RD-1234: make KV eviction non-blocking
- RD-1235: change batching heuristic to detect eviction stalls
Maria: RD-1236: add per-tenant soft limits + alerting for prefix tokens and eviction spikes.
Tom: Will canary the batching heuristic on a dedicated pool next week.
Jason: Add a CI perf regression test that reproduces eviction-heavy workload.
Aisha: I'll write the postmortem. Impact window: 14:01–14:12 UTC. Owners: Maria (rate limits/alerting), Jason (KV async evict prototype), Tom (batching canary), Aisha (postmortem).
Maria: Adding follow-ups and prioritizing RD-1234/5/6 in sprint.
Aisha: Closing once postmortem draft is up. :thumbsup:
